name: noncommCoprod_injective
statement: Type*} [Group M] [Group N] [Group P] (f : M →* P) (g : N →* P) (comm : ∀ (m : M) (n : N), Commute (f m) (g n)) : Function.Injective (noncommCoprod f g comm) ↔ (Function.Injective f ∧ Function.Injective g ∧ _root_.Disjoint f.range g.range)
